rules: Exclude all twenty first-round methods and renamed/depth/width variations
Non-MSA/non-MERC primary papers and actual author code must be inspected before acceptance
Retain meaningful complete transferable mechanisms, not isolated primitive operators
No changes to causal OSRAM read/write/query, task head, task loss or missing schedule

Passing candidates enter fixed-protocol seed66 training on biggpu; GPU4 and its UUID banned

All adaptive test-oracle results remain INTERNAL DIAGNOSTIC ONLY
